subject: Kickoff: vendor onboarding evidence manifest & PO routing
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Leah Turner <leah.turner@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Kickoff: vendor onboarding evidence manifest & PO routing

Hi Leah —

Thanks for moving this forward. I wanted to start a short kickoff thread so we can lock the procurement prerequisites and PO flow for Crestline Health. Attached is a lightweight evidence manifest and our procurement onboarding form to speed intake. Key asks from your side to get to contracting: 

  - Confirm preferred PO number format and billing contact (we can accept PO via email to billing@redwood.com or upload to DocuSign).
  - Provide remit-to address & POC for AP.
  - Confirm what level of SOC 2 evidence is acceptable (we typically provide SOC 2 Type II with selective redaction).
  - Confirm whether an ISO27001 certificate and a signed pen-test attestation letter will satisfy your security gate.
  - Any additional vendor forms (supplier questionnaire, diversity forms, etc.).

Attached: redwood-evidence-manifest-v1.pdf (PDF) — short checklist of what we can supply; procurement-onboarding-form.xlsx (Excel) — please fill the top section and return. Also linking our shared onboarding folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-onboarding

Proposed timeline: provide initial evidence + PO template by end of this week (Fri, Nov 26). If you need legal review or an NDA prior to sharing anything, say the word and I’ll loop Legal.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-evidence-manifest-v1.pdf (PDF)]
[attachment: procurement-onboarding-form.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Leah Turner <leah.turner@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@crestlinehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-22T10:07:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor onboarding evidence manifest & PO routing

Ben —

Appreciate the clear checklist. A few clarifications so we can route quickly to our InfoSec and AP: 

  - SOC 2: InfoSec prefers the full Type II report, but will accept a redacted copy if it includes auditor opinion and control coverage summary.
  - Pen test: We need a letter from an independent third-party confirming last external penetration test date and whether critical/high findings were remediated; a vulnerability scan alone is not sufficient.
  - ISO27001: Certificate OK.

For PO routing, we prefer vendor invoices to include a PO number and be sent to ap-payables@crestlinehealth.com; remit address should match W9. Can you confirm if you can provide a W9 and a billing contact email?

Also, do you have a standard sample PO clause for data handling / data residency that our contracts team can review?

Thanks — I’ll route the manifest to InfoSec and AP and get back with a single consolidated list.

-Leah
Leah Turner
Senior Procurement Manager
Crestline Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Leah Turner <leah.turner@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor onboarding evidence manifest & PO routing

Hi Leah —

Thanks — quick answers inline and I’ve attached the pen test attestation for your review.

  - SOC 2: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report with selective redaction of third-party vendor details and some internal hostnames. The auditor opinion page and control mapping will be intact. If you need the unredacted report, we can coordinate an NDA and a secure reader session.
  - Pen test attestation: attached is our current attestation (pen-test-attestation-letter.pdf) from our third-party assessor; it includes date, scope (external web-facing services and inference endpoints), and remediation status for high/critical items. If you need the full findings we can provide them under an NDA.
  - ISO27001: We hold ISO27001 certification; certificate is stashed in the onboarding drive link above.
  - W9: attached will be vendor-w9.pdf for AP.

Sample PO clause for data handling (high level):
  "Vendor shall process and store customer data only as necessary to provide the services described in the agreement. Vendor shall maintain security controls consistent with SOC 2 and ISO27001 requirements and shall notify Customer of any security incident within 72 hours of discovery."

Timeline: we can share the redacted SOC 2 + pen test attestation + W9 before EOD Thursday (Nov 25). If InfoSec requests the full SOC, please advise and I’ll kick off the NDA and secure delivery workflow (HubSpot: HS-45217).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Redwoods Partnerships
